page.title: Social accounts & posts
page.subtitle: Plan, approve and publish posts to Facebook, Instagram, Google and YouTube from one place.

accounts.title: Accounts

notConnectedHint.INSTAGRAM: Needs an Instagram business account linked to a Page
notConnectedHint.GOOGLE_BUSINESS: Updates on your Google Search and Maps listing

accounts.emptyHint: Connect your Facebook Page, Instagram, Google Business Profile or YouTube channel to start posting.
accounts.adminOnly: Only institute admins can connect or disconnect accounts.
accounts.disconnectBody: Scheduled posts will no longer go to this account. Posts already published stay where they are. You can connect it again at any time.

empty.title: Nothing planned for {{month}}
empty.body: Write a post once and send it to every network, now or on a schedule.

calendar.publishingHint: Publishing now. Videos can take a few minutes; this list refreshes on its own.

postNow.body: This publishes straight away to {{networks}}. Published posts can only be removed from each network itself.

cancel.title: Cancel this post?
cancel.body: It won’t be published. You can still find it under All.

delete.title: Delete this post?
delete.body: It will be removed from the calendar. Anything already published stays on {{networks}}.

composer.editingScheduled: You’re editing a scheduled post. Saving sends it back for approval.

noAccounts.title: No accounts ready to post
noAccounts.body: Connect an account on the left, or reconnect one that needs attention.

composer.droppedTargets_one: {{count}} account from this post is no longer connected and was removed.
composer.droppedTargets_other: {{count}} accounts from this post are no longer connected and were removed.

ai.briefPlaceholder: e.g. Admissions open for the 2027 batch, free demo class this Saturday at 10 am
ai.note: AI fills in the title, text and per-network versions. Check facts, dates and fees before posting.

composer.title: Title
composer.titleHint: For your team’s calendar. Not shown on Facebook, Instagram or Google.
composer.titleYoutubeHint: Also used as the YouTube video title (first {{max}} characters).

overrides.label: Tailor the text per network
overrides.hint: Leave a box empty to use the main text for that network.

media.label: Photos or video
media.hint: Drop images or one video here, or use Add.
media.rules: Up to 10 images, or one video. Instagram needs at least one; YouTube needs one video; Google Business takes images only.
media.uploadFailed: Couldn’t upload {{name}}. Remove it and try again.
media.onlyFirst_one: Only the first file was added (10 files at most).
media.onlyFirst_other: Only the first {{count}} files were added (10 files at most).

schedule.label: When to post
schedule.hintAdmin: Pick a date and time to schedule, or use Post now.
schedule.hintStaff: Optional. Suggest a time; an admin approves it.

issues.heading: Fix these before posting
issues.empty: Add a title, some text or media.
issues.uploadFailed: Remove the files that failed to upload.
issues.mixedMedia: Use either images or a video, not both.
issues.oneVideo: Use only one video per post.
issues.badLink: Enter a full link starting with https://
issues.tooLong: Text for {{platform}} is over its {{max}}-character limit.
issues.instagramMedia: Instagram needs at least one image or video.
issues.youtubeVideo: YouTube needs exactly one video and no images.
issues.googleNoVideo: Google Business Profile can’t post video. Use images or text only.
issues.needsText: {{platform}} needs some text, a link or an image.
issues.googleNeedsText: Google Business Profile needs some text.
issues.tooLongWithLink: Text for {{platform}}, including the link, is over its {{max}}-character limit.
issues.youtubeTitle: Add a title or text for the YouTube video.
issues.scheduleIncomplete: Pick both a date and a time, or clear the schedule.
issues.schedulePast: That time has already passed. Pick a later time.
issues.scheduleRequired: Pick a date and time to schedule this post.

composer.staffNote: An admin reviews and schedules your post.
